principle: Historical archives measure observables, not Pineland latent states. Operators are licensed only at the narrowest construct level supported by source semantics and independent evidence.
global_prohibitions: violence event counts must not be treated as territorial control
violence event counts must not be treated as rooted membership mass
armed-group presence must not be treated as membership magnitude
security-force headcount must not be treated as veterancy or professionalism
aid or budget expenditure must not be treated as administrative capacity
source silence outside an explicit coverage frame must not be treated as a true zero
HES letter ratings must not be treated as interval-scale quantities without a separately frozen monotone/ordinal operator
